symptom: ako/mxcli#980 (found adding navigation profiles to the TestApp round-trip harness): describe -> exec of an offline profile rewrote every multi-line sync constraint as the one-line text describe prints
cause: navOfflineConfigs wrote the spec's constraint verbatim; describe folds Studio Pro's multi-line layout (singleLine) and the visitor re-normalises it, so the text never matches the stored bytes
insight: When describe deliberately changes layout, the writer must carry the stored layout for an unchanged value; compare with whitespace outside string literals removed (inside a literal it is part of the value — that is the control)
